newsitem.title: USA: USX unit to invest $40 million in plate mill.
newsitem.headline: USX unit to invest $40 million in plate mill.

text.p: USX Corp.'s U.S. Steel Plate Productions division said Monday it will invest about $40 million to modernise its 160-inch plate mill at the Gary Works.
The investment will improve quality and allow U.S. Steel to make more products for the high-carbon, alloy and stainless plate markets, the company said.

The company will install new heat-treating equipment to improve surface quality and make Gary's plate products more uniform. The new facilities will be able to treat at least 75,000 tons of plates annually in various widths and thicknesses.
The installation is expected to be completed in the second quarter of 1998.
The company said it would also install a roller support system on the mill's cooling bed to reduce friction and minimise scratching.
USX's stock rose 12.5 cents to $30.25 on the New York Stock Exchange in afternoon trading.
